callouts.label: An Uncovered Cough
callouts.hint: Find the child on the far left who is coughing into the open air.
callouts.description: Everyone coughs sometimes. Covering a cough keeps tiny wet droplets from traveling into the air and onto nearby things.

callouts.label: Germs Riding on Droplets
callouts.hint: Find the tiny turquoise and purple specks floating near the coughing child.
callouts.description: Germs are too small to see without special tools. A cough or sneeze can send germs riding through the air on tiny droplets.

callouts.label: A Shared Doorknob
callouts.hint: Find the shiny round object touched by the child entering the classroom.
callouts.description: Many hands touch a classroom doorknob. Germs can hitch a ride from a hand to the knob and then to the next hand.

callouts.label: Shared Blocks
callouts.hint: Find the colorful building blocks on the low activity table.
callouts.description: Sharing toys is fun. Because many children touch the same toys, washing hands after play helps stop germs from traveling farther.

callouts.label: Germs on Hands
callouts.hint: Find the two hands resting near the shared toys in the center of the picture.
callouts.description: Hands pick up germs when they touch shared objects. Hands can look clean and still need soap and water before eating or touching the face.

callouts.label: Touching the Face
callouts.hint: Find the child in the striped shirt with one finger near the nose.
callouts.description: Hands often touch the eyes, nose, and mouth without us noticing. Clean hands help keep germs from reaching the face.

callouts.label: Cough Into an Elbow
callouts.hint: Find the child in purple covering a cough with a bent arm.
callouts.description: Coughing or sneezing into the inside of an elbow helps keep droplets off hands, toys, and friends.

callouts.label: Tissue Into the Trash
callouts.hint: Find the tissue being dropped into the wastebasket.
callouts.description: A tissue can cover a cough or sneeze. Put the used tissue in the trash right away, then wash your hands.

callouts.label: Soap
callouts.hint: Find the blue pump bottle beside the sink.
callouts.description: Soap helps loosen germs from hands so clean running water can rinse them away.

callouts.label: Washing Hands
callouts.hint: Find the hands covered in white bubbles under running water.
callouts.description: Wet, add soap, scrub for about 20 seconds, rinse, and dry. Handwashing is one of the best ways to stop germs from spreading.
